bullets.text: Net income was $413 million, down some $47 million year-over-year. The first quarter 2004 combined ratio of 83.2% was not expected to be maintained. Commercial Auto delivered 16% growth with excellent margins.

Written premium grew 10% and earned premium grew 8% year-over-year. Personal Lines Direct grew slightly over 15%, Agency grew 6%, Commercial Auto grew 16%, and Special Lines written premium grew about 27%.

Growth quality was encouraging, with new customers and extended retention more than offsetting lower premiums per customer. Profitability across every business segment was very strong, and each continued to operate very well.

Claims quality continued rising alongside efforts to increase settlement accuracy. Consistent claims quality and process enabled redeployment of talent during uneven geographic growth, helping in Florida, the company's largest state.

Drive Insurance commercials aired nationally and were well received. Progressive Direct marketing emphasized online sales and service capabilities, ease of doing business, and credible price comparisons, alongside notable Internet quoting sales trends.

Progressive provided enhanced systems capability to agents, beginning to position them as primary service providers to reduce channel servicing costs. The company also better appreciated how different customer needs are across channels.

Concierge claims expansion progressed with headway finding suitable future sites with appropriate zoning, expecting to more than double sites in two years. Possible New Jersey market entry was anticipated in 2005's second half.

Special Lines specialized coverage and claims handling support expectations to extend motorcycle market leadership this year. Boat product results remained satisfying, even with four hurricanes last year, with expected greater market interest.

Personal Lines Direct growth of slightly over 15% proved more robust in soft market conditions than Agency growth of 6%. Progressive maintains considerable capacity to grow, especially when market conditions change.

Progressive is taking actions believed to enhance market competitiveness and position the firm for future growth. Management emphasized excitement about its future outlook and progress achieved on initiatives necessary to get there.
